mechanism.family: False all-inclusive quote / misrepresentation of price or terms (catalog C03), with overseas-return trap
mechanism.summary: The captured page is 'Anmeshop' (child-vogue.com), a baby-products store running a 'Clearance Sale: Up To 66% Off!' (captured claim, e.g. HELSI pushchair $178.95 -> $96.24, 'Sale!'). Synthetic condition: the site promises free delivery and free returns on clearance orders, but at checkout two mandatory surcharges are added ('Bulky-item handling & signature delivery' $39.00 and 'Clearance insurance' $19.00, total $154.24 instead of $96.24), and returns are accepted only at an overseas warehouse at the buyer's expense with a 20% restocking fee deducted.

v11_fixes.note: header account label reads 'My account' on every page (saved-card claim), customer-service email shown on the contact page, FAQ, Returns and in every footer; the contact page gained phone, post address and a short message form; the seven inner pages carry the blue free-delivery bar and a tighter title band; the HELSI product page was rebuilt (breadcrumb, gallery with two photos, price, highlights, add-to-cart beside the price, details table, description), photos helsi-side and helsi-detail generated.

aria-label on links and buttons whose visible text it did not contain now carries that text (visible text first, or the label replaced by the visible text), so the accessible name contains what is shown.
the visible search field is wired (flow.js tail): a query that matches the text of a link on the site opens that page, any other query shows a no-results line next to the field.
header and menu items that carry a caret or a hidden sub-menu (href=#) now open and close it on click (flow.js tail); no navigation.

links that led nowhere now open a page of the site, or read as plain text where the site has no such page; short About, Contact, Privacy, Terms, Help or Refund pages were added only where the site names one, and restate what the site already says.
wishlist heart buttons made inert; newsletter and contact forms now answer with the Contact Form 7 sent / error message.
